tasks.label: sh47
tasks.command:
cd web-client && cat > .tmp-edit.js <<'JS_EOF'
const fs = require('fs');

const path = 'src/core/api/serversErrors.ts';
const raw = fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
const crlf = raw.includes('\r\n');
let source = raw.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');

const block = [
  '',
  '// Ownership transfers (HU #10). `server` answers its refusals with a fixed',
  '// English message per rule (see contracts/ownership-transfer-api.md); the',
  '// client owns the copy, so the known ones are recognized by their key word',
  '// instead of being shown in English.',
  "const TRANSFER_NOT_PENDING = 'La transferencia ya no está pendiente.';",
  "const TRANSFER_OWNER_ONLY = 'Solo el dueño puede transferir la propiedad.';",
  "const TRANSFER_TARGET_ONLY = 'Solo el destinatario puede responder esta transferencia.';",
  "const TRANSFER_NOT_MEMBER = 'Esa persona ya no es miembro del servidor.';",
  "const TRANSFER_TO_OWNER = 'No podés transferirle la propiedad al dueño actual.';",
  '',
  '// The 400 of a new transfer is about the target (someone who isn\'t a member,',
  '// or the owner itself): its message decides which of the two copies applies.',
  'function transferTargetRefusal(cause: ApiError): string | null {',
  "  const message = messageFromBody(cause)?.toLowerCase() ?? '';",
  '  if (message.includes(\'member\')) {',
  '    return TRANSFER_NOT_MEMBER;',
  '  }',
  "  if (message.includes('yourself') || message.includes('owner')) {",
  '    return TRANSFER_TO_OWNER;',
  '  }',
  '  return null;',
  '}',
  '',
  '// Starting a transfer: 403 is the owner check, 400 the target\'s. A 404 (the',
  '// server is gone) and the network/upstream failures come from serversFormError.',
  'export function initiateTransferError(cause: unknown): string {',
  '  if (cause instanceof ApiError && cause.status === 403) {',
  '    return TRANSFER_OWNER_ONLY;',
  '  }',
  '  if (cause instanceof ApiError && cause.status === 400) {',
  '    return transferTargetRefusal(cause) ?? TRANSFER_NOT_PENDING;',
  '  }',
  '  return serversFormError(cause);',
  '}',
  '',
  '// Answering a transfer: 400 means it is no longer PENDING (it was accepted,',
  '// rejected or cancelled elsewhere — the caller reloads its list), 403 that the',
  '// caller is not its target.',
  'export function transferResponseError(cause: unknown): string {',
  '  if (cause instanceof ApiError && cause.status === 400) {',
  '    return TRANSFER_NOT_PENDING;',
  '  }',
  '  if (cause instanceof ApiError && cause.status === 403) {',
  '    return TRANSFER_TARGET_ONLY;',
  '  }',
  '  return serversFormError(cause);',
  '}',
  '',
].join('\n');

source = source.trimEnd() + '\n' + block;
fs.writeFileSync(path, crlf ? source.replace(/\n/g, '\r\n') : source);
console.log('ok');
JS_EOF
node .tmp-edit.js && rm .tmp-edit.js && git diff src/core/api/serversErrors.ts | tail -55
